★ Request
Show Fusaichi Pandora (Casual Clothes)

Hey, what do ya say about teaming up with me? You'd
get to take it suuuper easy too, y'know? 'Cause I'll win without you having to do a thing♪

I understood loud and clear what kind of Umamusume Fusaichi Pandora was.
This girl was...

And after begging to ride it herself, this was the result.
Furthermore, on the way home from the amusement park...

...Her running earlier proved beyond a doubt that she has raw talent.
However...

Contract, contract♪ Let's get it done already☆
Do I need a stamp or something? Here, I'll just stamp it right here♡

Hey, let's ride that! The scream machine one! And put our hands up☆
Let's scream "Eeeeeeek!!" together!
Huh? Conditions...?

Begging from point-blank range...
Looking into those sparkling eyes...

Earlier she said I "smelled sweet," but...
Could it be the scent of the dessert I had after lunch?

Come on, come on! It'll totally look great on you~
Let's post it on UmaSta. Pretty please...?
Stop!! Snap out of it, it's a trap!

So close, just a little more!
And here I thought I'd finally found ya.

Hey, you're a Trainer too, right?
Then won't you...

Hey hey, Trainer, put that one on, put it on!
And let's do matching outfits♪

My friends are pretty much like that too.
If I just go "Pretty please!", they'll listen to whatever I say☆

What I found is a super sweet Trainer
who'll have lots of fun hanging out with me♪
Won't you scout me?

That talent of hers is buried deep in a swamp of sugar...
Even if I try to dig it up, one wrong move and I'll be swallowed whole.

A talk... Okay, got it! Let's chat, let's chat☆
Alrighty, this Sunday then♡

Just sign the Trainer contract already☆
Come on, why not♪

On the way home the three of us wore cute clothes~, and from all the sweets we ordered together,
they let me eat whatever I wanted~☆
Huh... why?

She imposes her own preferences without a second thought.
And once again—

Trainer, let's swap for that almond tofu♡
Oh, and throw in that iced tea too☆

I was on the verge of being dragged into the Pandora swamp.
The reason I just couldn't write her off despite her seductive charm was...
That was my best effort at resisting this sweet-talking little devil.

It would be such a waste to leave her talent buried like this.
In that case, a middle ground would be...

Without even waiting for my answer, she swiftly swaps
my almond tofu with her mapo tofu. She seems to lack common manners, but...

Eeeh~, wouldn't something that hard be totally gross?
I want something much softer and fluffier...

Huh~, am I really that carefree~?
It's always like this whenever I go to the amusement park with Mommy and Daddy, though?

Ugh, waaaaah~!
This Pinky Mapo Tofu is way spicier than I thought!!

Whoa, is that the new spring collection!? I'm gonna try it on☆
It'll totally suit me, and it's super duper cute♡

I'm amazing, you know! In mock races,
all I have to do is jog lightly and it's a breeze. So—
Gyaaaaaah! Bleeegh, oooof~~~!!

We've totally talked enough by now, right?
We spent the whole day together. So with that said—

An Umamusume raised in absolute pampering...
Her talent is unquestionable, but...
Hey, not yet~? The stamp, the stamp♪

That run of hers... Her form was magnificent. Getting her to take running seriously
might be an astronomical challenge. Even so—

Urgh... Oh no... gross...
Trainer, find somewhere to rest...

I can't agree to a contract without truly knowing her inside.
Not until I'm certain she has potential to succeed as an athlete.

I snapped back to my senses. I was almost completely
wrapped around this marshmallow Umamusume's little finger...

It didn't quite end with "let's talk in the Trainer's room right away..."
And so—the following Sunday arrived.
Yaaaay, a-muse-ment park!♡
